svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Sequence of a Cargo storage setup: Cargo asks Atlas for a machine as tenant 0; Atlas calls Metal; Cargo polls Atlas until the machine runs and has a mesh address; Cargo installs Garage over SSH through the mesh and joins it to the layout through the Garage admin API; Cargo writes the S3 routes to the HTTP proxy; Cargo tells Central with a webhook that the cluster is usable.
